title: Zero-dimensional quadratic systems
statement: For every finite list $L$ of homogeneous quadratic equations over the binary field in zero variables, either every Boolean assignment on the empty coordinate set satisfies every equation in $L$, or no such assignment satisfies the system.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a finite list of homogeneous quadratic equations over the binary field
